verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated Files docs page for modifying and interacting with files on a devbox [runloop-docs-63]. Its SDK context files explicitly cover "file operations" [runloop-docs-29], and official Python/TypeScript SDKs exist [runloop-docs-23, runloop-docs-44]. Storage Objects add a way to store and share files across Devboxes [runloop-docs-20]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of distinct read, write, upload, and download SDK methods (only generic "modify and interact" wording), no code examples, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
